name: BAAS
what_it_is: Backend as a Service, or BaaS (sometimes referred to as mBaaS) is a cloud computing category that make it easier for developers to setup, use and operate a cloud backend for their mobile, tablet and web apps.It provides web and mobile app developers with a way to link their applications to the cloud storage. They also add features such as user management, push notifications, and integration with social networking services for enhancement. These services are provided through customized Software Development Kits (SDKs) and Application Programming Interfaces (APIs).
